name: lazarus-resurrection
description: Autonomously resurrects legacy ES5 / CommonJS code (single files or whole require() graphs) into ES2022 + strict TypeScript, and proves it: exact Object.is differential fuzzing in an isolated sandbox with speculative AST-rule rollback, AST mutation audits of the proof itself, and tsc --strict verification, ending in a SHA-256 Resurrection Certificate and a PR bundle.
